title: Immersion pullback preserves punctual spectrum and residue size
statement: Let D be a finite-field datum, l a prime distinct from its characteristic, and Qbar an algebraic closure of the l-adic field, in a universe independent of that of D. For a locally closed immersion h0 of separated finite-type finite-field schemes and a closed source point z, its image x is closed and the two residue fields have equal cardinality. Every eigenvalue of the specified local Frobenius on the canonical pullback of a constructible Weil sheaf F at z is a local eigenvalue of F at x. No weight, purity or complex embedding is assumed. Uses [def-weil-constructible-heart; def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex; def-weil-punctual-weights; def-weil-closed-immersion; def-weil-open-immersion; def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom; def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category].

proof.text: The scheme X0 is Jacobson since it is locally of finite type over a field. Mathlib Scheme.Hom.closePoints_subset_preimage_closedPoints gives the closed image. A locally closed immersion is surjective on stalks; the proved source lemma Scheme.Hom.isIso_residueFieldMap identifies the actual residue fields. Nat.card_congr gives equality of their cardinalities.

lean.statement:
theorem zlCanonicalImmersionPunctualSpectrum (h₀ : W₀ ⟶ X₀) [IsImmersion h₀.left]
    (z : {z : W₀.left // z ∈ closedPoints W₀.left}) :
    ∃ hx : h₀.left z.val ∈ closedPoints X₀.left,
      Nat.card (W₀.left.residueField z.val) =
        Nat.card (X₀.left.residueField (h₀.left z.val)) ∧
      ∀ (F : sfCommonStageWeilSheaf D l hl X₀ Qbar) (α : Qbar),
        SfPunctualEigenvalue D l hl Qbar W₀ ((zlWeilPull D l hl Qbar h₀).obj F) z α →
          SfPunctualEigenvalue D l hl Qbar X₀ F ⟨h₀.left z.val, hx⟩ α
